cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Reverse the Score
cards.instruction: Turn each apparent loss into a new category of victory, then invite comparison on those changing terms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. The small trophy is better. It shows restraint.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Exactly. How gracefully can your enormous cup fit in a cupboard?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And mine doesn't need to shout. Another victory in modesty.

mechanism: A treats its former competitor pupil trophy as an inferior object by teaching new comparisons in storage and modesty that favor A consolation prize.
confusable: Not merely modest acceptance of losing: A actively declares fresh wins and demands comparison against the actual winner.
comparison: Race observation versus trophy utility and showiness.
seedUse: D235 small trophy/consolation/cupboard/first/modesty; S05 trained winning manners.
